notes.title: Sprout is just getting started
notes.excerpt: This is version 1, and your garden is still young. Much more is on its way.
body: Sprout is on version 1, which means it is still very early in its life.
There is a lot more coming: new plants, new views and many small touches, and we will keep polishing every corner of the app.
If you find a bug, or have an idea or a kind word to share, please write to us at sproutgardensupport@gmail.com. We read every message.
Stay tuned, and thank you for growing with us.

notes.title: Hello from the gardener
notes.excerpt: A small post box for a small garden. This is where I will tell you what is new, now and then.
body: Hi, I am Hirdyansh, the gardener behind Sprout.
Every plant, every pot and every little detail here is made with care, so your habits can grow at their own gentle pace.
This post box is where I will write to you now and then: what is new in your garden, small tips, and sometimes a question.
Thank you for planting something with me.

notes.title: Could you help Sprout grow?
notes.excerpt: If Sprout makes your days a little brighter, a rating helps others find it.
body: If Sprout has made your days a little brighter, a rating on the App Store helps more people find it.
It takes ten seconds, and it means a lot to a tiny app made by one person. No pressure, ever.
